design_decisions: Camera stores ONLY semantic parameters (eye/target/worldUp/verticalFOV/aspect/near/far), never a View/Projection matrix - all backend matrix construction (bx::mtxLookAt/bx::mtxProj) lives entirely inside bim::viewport_bgfx::Renderer::RenderFrame (renderer.cpp), per Implementation Brief section 5. This corrects Claude's own earlier Phase B design, which had exposed ViewMatrix()/ProjectionMatrix() on Camera directly.

ViewportLifecycle has exactly 6 stable states (Uninitialized/SurfaceUnavailable/Ready/Suspended/ShuttingDown/Destroyed); surface creation/recreation/destruction are modeled as EVENTS (BeginInitialization/OnSurfaceAvailable/OnSurfaceLost/OnSuspend/OnResume/BeginShutdown/CompleteShutdown) driving transitions between them, never as additional persistent states. This corrects Claude's own earlier Phase B design, which had a 7th state (SurfaceRecreated).

RenderMeshHandle carries an epoch tag (Renderer::Impl::epoch); ordinary Resize()/reset does not change the epoch (handles survive), but a full Shutdown()+Initialize() cycle increments it, so any handle from before that cycle is permanently stale afterward even if slot indices are reused. DestroyMesh on a stale-epoch, already-destroyed, or default-constructed handle returns ResourceNotFound, never aliasing another mesh's GPU resource.

ViewportErrorCode is a 10-value, code-only enum (None/InvalidInput/InvalidState/SurfaceUnavailable/RendererInitializationFailed/UnsupportedBackend/InvalidMesh/ResourceCreationFailed/ResourceNotFound/BackendFailure); Status/Result<T> carry only this code, no diagnostic string - deliberately different from the existing bim::foundation::Status (which has a std::string message_), per the Brief's contract for this module.

R11 also forbids dxgi.h/IDXGI tokens, a disclosed addition stricter than a bare 'no direct D3D11' reading.

InstallTopLevelWindowStateBridge() installs the filter on window() (Qt's own accessor for the actual top-level widget in the current parent chain - resolves to the enclosing MainWindow once embedded, or to ViewportWindow itself in the degenerate top-level-only case), removing it from any previously-observed top-level first; called from the constructor (fallback binding) and showEvent() (re-binds once real MainWindow::setCentralWidget()-style reparenting has completed and the widget is shown); idempotent. eventFilter() reacts only to QEvent::WindowStateChange observed on the tracked top-level widget, driving the identical lifecycle_.OnSuspend()/OnResume() + render_timer_ stop/start logic Round 4's changeEvent() performed, and never consumes any event (returns the base-class result) - explicitly not a revival of the M08 input-eventFilter assumption Round 2 removed, since it only inspects window-state events on the top-level widget, never input.
